1.why: Text uses a clean sans-serif typeface with comfortable letter and line spacing across all screens, though not a specifically dyslexia-optimized font.

2.why: Instructions use sentence case without italics or all-caps and avoid dense text blocks throughout the flow.

3.why: Layout is single-column, spacious, and clearly readable at mobile width in every screenshot.

4.why: All instructions are short plain-language sentences such as “Enter the six-digit code” and “Save them somewhere private.”

5.why: Input fields show examples like “Example: 123456” and “Example: ABCD-EFGH-JKLM” on identity, authenticator, and recovery screens.

6.why: No screen requires reading a long block of text; content is limited to brief headings, one-line instructions, and short status banners.

7.why: Copy buttons are provided for the manual setup secret (“Copy setup secret”) and recovery codes (“Copy all codes”).

8.why: A “Show QR setup pattern” option displays a scannable QR code as an alternative to typing the secret.

9.why: Email and code fields are standard inputs that can work with autofill/password managers, but no explicit autocomplete attributes or password-manager affordances are visible.

10.why: Progress bar, clear page headings, and a prominent blue primary button make the current step and main action stand out on every screen.

11.why: Each screen presents a single primary action (Send identity code, Check code, Confirm authenticator, I saved my codes, etc.).

12.why: Green status banners after each action plainly state what happened and what is next (e.g., “Identity checked. Next, set up your authenticator.”).

13.why: Users can request another code, show/hide secrets and recovery codes, and retry entry without penalty or lockout.

14.why: The visible error (“Your page check expired. Refresh the page and try again.”) states the problem and fix without blame; other field-level errors are not shown but the pattern is constructive.

15.why: No reading or OTP entry timers appear, yet a “page check expired” message indicates some session timeout exists, so time pressure is not fully absent.
